generatedFor: npm audit of 2026-10-13 after the F00 upgrade and the re-audit of 2026-10-27 (next 16.4.3); rows cover every high/critical advisory reported before each upgrade

rows.evidence: Needs an attacker-supplied AVIF to reach the /_next/image optimizer. next.config.ts has no images config (default formats, no remotePatterns/localPatterns reach), public/ holds only jpg/png/svg/webp, and no code imports sharp. Patched by upgrade.
Needs exactly one entry in config.i18n.locales with Turbopack. next.config.ts has no i18n. proxy.ts auth is therefore not bypassable through this path. Patched by upgrade.
Needs a Server Action behind an untrusted Host header. The app defines no Server Actions and runs the standalone server (host pinned since 14.2). Patched by upgrade.
Vendor workaround states apps with no images.remotePatterns are not affected. next.config.ts sets none. Patched by upgrade.
Vendor states apps without Server Actions are not vulnerable. The app defines none. Patched by upgrade.
Windows-filesystem hosts only. Production runs node:22-alpine (Dockerfile) on Linux. Developer Windows machines are covered by the upgrade.
Needs rewrites()/redirects() with a request-derived external hostname. next.config.ts defines neither. Patched by upgrade.
Requires attacker-controlled values in ImageResponse SVG content. The only use is app/opengraph-image.tsx, which renders static fonts and the app icon, no request input. Patched by upgrade.

Memory bug in the sharp/libvips build the image optimizer uses on glibc Linux; the vendor workaround is sharp >= 0.35.5. The lockfile already resolved sharp 0.35.5 before the upgrade, production runs node:22-alpine (musl), next.config.ts has no images config (no remotePatterns, SVG not rasterised), and no code imports next/image. Patched by upgrade.
Needs a `use cache` function (Cache Components) that returns typed arrays. No `use cache` directive exists and next.config.ts does not enable cacheComponents. Patched by upgrade.
Vendor states apps without Server Actions are not vulnerable. The app defines none (no 'use server' directive). Patched by upgrade.

sharp is only used by the Next.js image optimizer. Inputs are limited to the repository public/ assets (no AVIF/HEIC; SVG is not rasterised by default); no remotePatterns; app code never imports sharp. Patched by upgrade (next 16.4.0 requires sharp ^0.35.4).
